name: Jairus
overview: Jairus, identified as a ruler of the synagogue in Capernaum, approaches Jesus with deep faith, pleading for the healing of his daughter who is at the point of death. Despite the skepticism of those around, Jesus declares the girl is merely sleeping and then miraculously restores her to life, demonstrating His authority over death. This account highlights both Jairus's faith and Jesus's power to bring life, as the news of this miracle spread throughout the land.
